design_intent.philosophy: High heights are less stable, reduce position authority for safety

low_heights_0p30m.rationale: More stable, can tolerate stronger corrections

design_intent.paired_with: increased wheel damping at high heights

architectural_conflict.tuned_cap_expects: Raw torque up to 7.5 Nm to enable graduated authority
architectural_conflict.result: Tuned emergency caps (7.0/8.0 Nm) never activated

arguments_for_keeping_4nm: May have empirical basis from Phase 6 testing
arguments_for_raising_to_6_8nm: Empirical demand shows 7.485 Nm peak is legitimate
Tuned cap layer designed for 7-8 Nm suggests intent
Safety gates already exist in APCR1n
Emergency authority only used in severe drift (rare)

recommended_solution.description: Keep 4.0 Nm for normal operation, allow 7-8 Nm during APCR1n emergency with safety gates passing
benefits: Enables emergency authority when truly needed

alternative_solution.description: Make emergency cap height-aware: 8.0 Nm at >= 0.45m, 6.0 Nm below

unknown_factors: Why Phase 6 was needed - what failed before?
Whether unpublished data shows 4.0 Nm is necessary
Whether Phase 6 designer knew about tuned cap layer
Whether tuned cap designer knew about upstream scheduling
next_phase: Design architecture-fix candidates using emergency bypass approach
